definitions.label_target: evaluator zone queue/class of the client's own approach at end_t + horizon
definitions.missing_value_policy: None = unavailable (mask); never zero-filled; empty RSU zone has no mean speed/wait
definitions.queue_definition: contiguous halted chain (speed<=0.1 m/s) starting within 15.0 m of the stop line, bumper gaps <= 10.0 m, measured to rear bumper, capped at the target zone
definitions.window_rule_rsu: last history_len consecutive report steps (all present)
definitions.window_rule_vehicle: last history_len consecutive report steps, ALL with scope=incoming_local
